profile.headline: Team Lead, Backend Developer, Dev Manager, Tech Consultant
profile.summary: I am a full stack developer with experience using a wide range of technologies and a track record of successful projects.  I specialize in building custom websites, e-commerce, and systems integration.

positions.title: Backend Developer Manager
positions.description: Dev Manager of the Backend Integrations team

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Built a custom product configuration system that bridged the gap between their business processes and ERP.
Contributed to strategic and architectural planning for a transition and consolidation of two separate IT ecosystems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
·	Built Reporting Dashboards for Teachers and School Administrators that showed class and internship progress.  It included animated graphs of demographics breakdowns and other key statistics, and also dynamic filtering of the data.
·	Created a system to manage and distribute Testing Resources to test proctors.  The documents are stored in Amazon S3 cloud storage, replacing the old process of mailing CDs.
·	 Rewrote a Test Management and Publishing software suite, adding new randomization and question group features.
·	Added new custom SEO features, including Google schema.org markup with Microdata and JSON-LD.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on many different projects for a large enterprise level ecommerce site with 14 major brands and 27 different countries.  Responsibilities included planning, functional specification, quoting, and implementation.  
•	Project Lead on a 3-month website revamp project with a team of three other developers.  Assessed the existing platform, and wrote the functional specifications and estimates for the project.  Managed the project through its entire lifecycle and presented milestones to the cli-ent.
•	Mentored Junior Developers and Interns while working on projects such as a custom FMLA management intranet site, which included development of a VXML based Interactive Voice Response phone system.
•	Built an enterprise scale product management system that integrated with a big box CMS and featured complex search, and mass editing through import/export of Excel docs.
•	Improved and expanded the Data Warehouses for several different clients.  Built an SSIS process to integrate data from Omniture into the existing consumer data.

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description: Performed regression and robustness testing on the car stereo Bluetooth interface for Honda.

positions.title: Intern Web Application Developer
positions.description: Designed and built an internal web application for reporting Small Group activity.
